package.name: rover_contract
package.description: D555/ESP32 impersonation layer: republishes the sim's internal topics as the exact real-robot contract (/camera/camera0/*, wall-clock stamps, captured real intrinsics + static frame tree) and emulates the rover firmware's /cmd_vel behavior (PWM deadband, watchdog). The Jetson/Pi5 stack runs unchanged and cannot tell it is in simulation.
